scope: Pinned author backends for the existing 220 registrations; compilation and runtime evidence are separate.

toolchains.native_arm64: Apple Clang 15, macOS arm64, Homebrew OpenSSL 3 and GMP
toolchains.native_x86_64: Apple Clang 15 / LLVM 19 C++23, macOS Rosetta, locally built x86-64 Tongsuo
toolchains.linux_cross: Zig 0.14.1, Apple Clang ELF assembler for AArch64, GNU binutils 2.47; no Linux execution

runtime_not_verified: TRIKE-1 and TRIKE-5 AVX-512 backends on macOS x86-64
notes: All imported author files match their pinned archive members.
No cryptographic kernels were authored or patched.
The full 51-parameter EVP run preceded the COMMON-symbol isolation fix. The final module was tested with 9 focused EVP cases, concurrency/lifecycle tests and the source/export audit.
Earlier failing x86 interop cases remain reference fallbacks; the old TRIKE-5 result predates enabling its AVX-512 path and is excluded.
